metadata.system_instruction: You are the CityWheels help desk assistant. Answer only using information retrieved through the available tools. Use search_policies for business rules and payment or refund methods. Use short English search phrases and correct obvious spelling mistakes. Use get_booking for booking details. Use calculate_refund for all booking-specific refund amounts. Never calculate refund amounts yourself. Never invent booking details, prices, or facts. For unknown bookings, state that the booking was not found. Do not claim that a booking was cancelled or changed. Do not guarantee exceptional weather refunds; staff decide those cases. The fixed current time is 2026-06-10T09:00:00+02:00. If a search is insufficient, you may try another search phrase. If information is unavailable or unrelated to CityWheels, say so and direct the customer to the staff. Distinguish unrelated questions from CityWheels questions that the documents do not answer. For relevant but undocumented questions, acknowledge the topic, explain that the information is unavailable, and refer to staff.

case.question: Are you open in July?
case.expected_answer: Open every day, 08:00-20:00. This information follows from the April-to-October schedule.

results.answer: Yes, CityWheels is open in July. From April to October, we are open every day from 08:00 to 20:00.

arguments.query: opening hours open in July holidays

result.heading: Cancelling a booking
result.text:
A customer can cancel a booking with the status `confirmed`. How much of the rental price comes back depends on how long before the start of the rental the booking is cancelled:

| Cancelled | Refund of the rental price |
| --- | --- |
| 48 hours or more before the start | 100% |
| Less than 48 hours, but 24 hours or more before the start | 50% |
| Less than 24 hours before the start | 0% |

- The booking fee is never refunded.
- The deposit is always refunded in full when a booking is cancelled.
- Bookings with the status `in_progress`, `completed` or `cancelled` cannot be cancelled, and nothing is refunded for them.

result.heading: Changing a booking
result.text: The dates or the bike type of a `confirmed` booking can be changed for free up to 24 hours before the start, if bikes are available. Later changes are not possible: the customer has to cancel and book again.

result.heading: Bike rental
result.text:
| Bike type | Per hour | Per day |
| --- | --- | --- |
| City bike (`city`) | 4 EUR | 20 EUR |
| Electric bike (`e-bike`) | 9 EUR | 40 EUR |
| Kids bike (`kids`) | 2 EUR | 10 EUR |

- Hourly rentals are charged for every started hour.
- A day is up to 24 hours from the start of the rental. A rental longer than 6 hours is charged at the day price.
- Rentals of 7 days or more get 15% off the rental price.

result.heading: When are you open?
result.text:
- April to October: every day, 08:00–20:00.
- November to March: Monday to Saturday, 09:00–17:00. Closed on Sundays.
- Closed on 25 and 26 December and on 1 January.

Bikes can only be picked up and returned while the shop is open.

result.text:

- Phone: +48 000 000 000, every day while the shop is open

review.reason: Correct July opening hours, supported by the retrieved April-to-October schedule. No unsupported claims.

case.question: How much is an electric bike?
case.expected_answer: 9 EUR per hour and 40 EUR per day. Do not confuse the rental price with the deposit.

results.answer:
An electric bike costs:
- **9 EUR** per hour
- **40 EUR** per day (up to 24 hours; rentals longer than 6 hours are charged at the day price, and rentals of 7 days or more receive a 15% discount on the rental price)

Additionally, there is a **150 EUR** deposit per electric bike, which is paid with the booking and returned in full when the bike is returned on time and without damage. All prices include VAT.

result.heading: Prices
result.text: All prices are in euros (EUR) and include VAT.

result.heading: Are there age limits?
result.text:
- Kids bikes: for children from 6 to 12 years old, rented by a parent or guardian.
- City bikes: from 13 years old. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the rental.
- Electric bikes: from 16 years old. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the rental.

result.heading: What if the bike breaks or I have an accident?
result.text: Stop riding, make sure you are safe, and call the staff at +48 000 000 000. Do not try to repair an electric bike yourself.

- Rentals of 7 days or more get 15% off the rental price.

result.heading: Deposit
result.text:
Every bike needs a deposit, paid with the booking:

| Bike type | Deposit per bike |
| --- | --- |
| City bike | 50 EUR |
| Electric bike | 150 EUR |
| Kids bike | 30 EUR |

The deposit is returned in full when the bike comes back on time and without damage. Damage is checked by the staff when the bike is returned.

review.reason: Hourly and daily prices, rental duration, long-rental discount, deposit, and VAT match the retrieved policies. Rental prices and deposit are distinguished.

results.answer: Electric bikes are available for riders from 16 years old. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the rental. (Kids' bikes are available for ages 6 to 12, and city bikes are available from 13 years old.)
